description:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public data from GSA CALC+. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

Search awarded GSA MAS labor ceiling rates, compare labor categories, browse vendor rate cards, and explore SIN benchmarks through eight read-only tools. Rates are contract ceilings, not wages or prices paid. The app supports research and does not make a price-reasonableness determination.

defaultPrompt: Find five GSA CALC+ program manager labor ceiling rates.
Compare a proposed $150 hourly program manager rate with GSA CALC+ benchmarks.
Show labor categories and ceiling rates for a vendor returned by the search.
